title: Pixcart Event Envelope v1
description: Common envelope for every domain event (Vol.5 §5.5 EDA Contract). Consumers dedup by (topic, eventId); the outbox pattern guarantees the envelope is written in the SAME transaction as the state change (no dual-write). Payload PII is minimised to reference ids.

eventId.description: ULID; the idempotency key for consumers ((topic, eventId) dedup).

occurredAt.description: Business event time (UTC). Distinct from ingest time for courier-sourced events.

partitionKey.description: Ordering key; per Vol.5, payment/order events are ordered per orderId.

correlationId.description: Optional trace/correlation id spanning a request or saga.

data.description: Event-specific payload; schema per event type.
